ledShadowFix: Clustered LEDs use finite voxel-cell traversal from the biased origin to the emitter, excluding its cell. Cells before the light block; cells beyond it are never sampled. This avoids interpolated emitter SDF self-occlusion. Directional sunlight retains the existing 24-unit SDF march. LED shadows use the bounded coarse opacity grid; separate fractional shapes inside the emitter cell cannot be resolved.
